Benefits & Gains

WHAT YOU GAIN
WITH A REAL COACH

Personal training changes far more than the mirror. This is what you actually walk away with.

01

Fat Loss That Stays Off

No crash diets. A calorie and macro plan built around Indian food you already eat — so the fat comes off and does not come back the moment you stop.

02

Real Muscle & Strength

Progressive training that adds visible shape to your chest, arms, back and legs — and strength you feel in everyday life, not just in the gym.

03

Posture & Pain-Free Movement

Desk-job shoulders, tight hips and a weak lower back get corrected. Supervised form protects your knees, back and shoulders for the long run.

04

Energy That Lasts All Day

Better food timing, better sleep and better conditioning — no 4pm crash, no dragging yourself through the evening.

05

Protection From Diabetes & BP

Strength training and a controlled diet improve insulin sensitivity, blood pressure and cholesterol — the health markers that decide your next 30 years.

06

Confidence & Discipline

The habit you build here follows you into work, family and everything else. Clients leave with a body they are proud of and a routine they can keep.

The SpeedFit Method

HOW SPEEDFIT
TRANSFORMS YOU

A complete system — from assessment to transformation, monitored every single day. This is what makes SpeedFit different.

01
Complete Assessment First

Before any workout — your body posture, lifestyle and health issues, current fitness level, and overall BMI & BMR. We understand your body before we train it.

02
Designed For Your Goal

Your trainer designs your programme and Indian diet plan from that assessment — your goal, your body, your food, your schedule. No templates, ever.

03
Monitored Daily On The App

Diet, workouts, routine and progress — tracked daily through the exclusive SpeedFit client experience, with your coach watching every step.

04
Transformation, Made Easier

Assessment + custom design + daily monitoring: you reach your goal faster and keep the lifestyle for good.

Got Questions?

COMMON
QUESTIONS

Do I need a gym to train with SpeedFit?
No. Both gym-based and home workout programmes are available. Your plan is built around whatever equipment you have access to.
Can I follow the nutrition plan with Indian food?
Absolutely. All meal plans are built around Indian foods — rice, roti, dal, sabzi. No imported supplements or foreign diets required.
How quickly will I see results?
Most clients see visible results within 3 to 4 weeks. Significant transformations typically occur in 8 to 12 weeks with consistent execution.
Is online coaching as effective as in-person?
Yes. Online clients receive the same daily check-ins, custom plans, and weekly reviews. Many of the best transformations at SpeedFit are from online clients across India.
What if I am a complete beginner?
Many of our most successful clients started from zero. Your programme is built from your current fitness level — not someone else’s.
